outcome: Expression of key molecules involved in insulin signaling and glucose-lipid metabolism in adipose tissue
Homeostasis model assessment of insulin resistance (HOMA-IR)
cohort: Obese pregnant women with or without GDM and nonpregnant controls undergoing cesarean section or elective surgeries.
finding: Obese pregnant women with GDM have higher adipose tissue ENPP1 expression, which is associated with alterations in insulin signaling and glucose-lipid metabolism, suggesting a potential role for ENPP1 in mediating insulin resistance and hyperglycemia in GDM.
